Advertisement for Faculty
Saturday, 13 August 2016
7660 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram invites applications for the under mentioned temporary posts-
1.
Professor
in  TB and Chest
2.
Associate Professors
in Radiology and Psychiatry
2.
Assistant Professors
in General Surgery,  Radiodiagnosis and Anesthesiology
The applicant should send their application along with complete bio-data with necessary academic and experience certificates/testimonials to the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram. Dist. Wardha (MS) by
15 September
2016
.  The appointments would be adhoc till the next Selection Committee of MUHS meets.
Qualification: MBBS with MCI recognized Post Graduate degree in concerned subject
Experience: As per MCI and MUHS norms
Pay Scale : As per rules of Kasturba Health Society
For more details call at 07152 – 284341 to 284355 (Ext. 203)  or email at
khssgm@rediffmail.com
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
